description: Central Province - Regulation made to impose that the 'SAHASARA' Project is to be implemented on all routes where buses registered under Central Provincial Passenger Transport Service Authority
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a new regulation under specific statutes (Passenger Transport Services Authority Statute Number 01 of 2000 and Passenger Transportation Statute Number 04 of 1992). It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for transportation services in the Central Province, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. While a minister is named, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not about the minister's appointment or portfolio responsibilities.
